description: P(model has an exact reference CDS) for runs without Tiberius (Vipsania + Drusilla + TD2 candidates, protein and RNA-Seq evidence). HistGradientBoostingClassifier depth 3, 400 iterations, learning rate 0.05, trained on the keep-all pools of 15 validation species without the Tiberius gene set (clade-agnostic). raw = baseline + sum of leaf values; P = 1 / (1 + exp(-raw)). Node test: x <= thr -> left; NaN -> left if nan_left else right. The RNA multiplicity is normalised by the median over the structures predicted by all tools of the run (three here). Thresholds: the species-out cross-validation optimum 0.225 / 0.30, also for clades outside the HC table (the clades this model is for). On 31 benchmark species without Tiberius: 57.4 transcript / 71.2 gene F1, Vipsania alone 44.2 / 54.8, the run with Tiberius 60.1 / 74.6 (Nov 2026).
